compressed_research.topic_text:
Research home studio audio gear recommendations and learning resources for an independent musician with a total project budget of 20,000 RMB. Specifically research:
1. Audio Equipment Selection (budget allocation around 3,000 to 6,000 RMB out of 20,000 RMB):
   - Large diaphragm condenser microphone suitable for acoustic guitar and vocal recording (e.g., Rode NT1/NT1-A, Audio-Technica AT2020/AT4040, Aston Origin, AKG P220/P420).
   - 2-in/2-out Audio Interface (e.g., Focusrite Scarlett 2i2 4th Gen, MOTU M2, Audient iD4/iD14 MKII, Solid State Logic SSL2).
   - MIDI Keyboard (25 or 37/49 keys suitable for basic piano and synth entry, e.g., Arturia KeyStep / MiniLab 3, Novation Launchkey 37).
   - Essential accessories: Pop filter, sturdy desktop or floor mic stand, acoustic desktop shield / acoustic panel treatment for non-treated rooms, standard XLR cables, TRS cables.
   - Provide direct shopping links to JD.com (https://www.jd.com), Tmall (https://www.tmall.com), or official manufacturer product pages for each item.
2. DAW Selection and Learning Resources:
   - Compare DAWs best suited for indie pop and folk acoustic arrangements (Logic Pro for macOS, Ableton Live, Cubase, Studio One, Reaper).
   - Identify specific high-quality Bilibili creators, courses, or structured video series for:
     a) Mastering the selected DAW workflow.
     b) Acoustic guitar and vocal recording techniques (mic placement, room treatment tips).
     c) Indie pop and folk music arrangement (layering acoustic guitars, bass, subtle synth/strings, percussion).
     d) Home studio mixing and mastering basics (EQ, compression, reverb, delay, limiting for streaming LUFS target).
